speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss; these are concerning symptoms that require a thorough investigation. To begin, how long have you been feeling this way, and have you noticed any night sweats or fevers?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant amount of weight loss over just six months. To help narrow down the cause, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, or have you experienced any lumps, night sweats, or fevers?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text: The weight loss of 18.1 kg is severe; have you noticed any swollen lymph nodes, persistent cough, or blood in your stool? REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP, ESR, LDH. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
